title: How to Find Coupon Codes That Actually Work
excerpt: A practical checklist for finding promo codes that apply at checkout — every time.
author: Editorial Team
body:
## Start with verified sources
Use a coupon site that tests codes and shows a success rate, so you skip the dead ones.

## Try more than one code
Reveal two or three and keep whichever gives the biggest discount at checkout.

## Watch the fine print
Check expiry dates, minimum spend and whether a code stacks with a sale.

title: 5 Couponing Mistakes That Cost You Money
excerpt: Avoid these common slip-ups and never overpay at checkout again.
author: Editorial Team
body:
## 1. Not comparing codes
Always test a couple and keep the biggest discount.

## 2. Ignoring expiry dates
Expired codes waste time — use a site that removes them.

## 3. Missing the cashback
Some offers stack with cashback or rewards.

## 4. Forgetting minimum spend
Add one more item only if it truly saves money.

## 5. Skipping the newsletter code
Many stores give a first-order discount for signing up.
